about: Reazioni ai tocchi (Blocco 5b), generate con npm run kimodo -- --series scripts/kimodo-series-touch.json --out private-assets/animations --keep-raw. Gesti brevi, una clip per slot. turnaway non si volta: il giro di spalle lo fa il player (yaw della clip in vrm-animation.js), e una clip che si gira da sola lo raddoppierebbe. "crosses the arms" non basta: Kimodo gesticola; "arms folded across the chest" e "facing forward" si. shy usa il seme 2 (con il seme 1 si volta quasi di schiena). Vedi docs/kimodo-prompts.md.

clips.prompt: A person tilts the head to one side and lowers the shoulders, relaxed and content, then straightens up.
A person flinches, pulling the head and upper body back quickly in surprise, then relaxes.
A person giggles, bending forward slightly with both hands on the belly, shoulders shaking.
A person does a small hop in place and lands softly.
A person stands facing forward, lowers the head and glances to the side shyly, hands clasped in front of the body.
A person stands facing forward with the arms folded across the chest and shakes the head slowly.
A person stands still with the arms folded across the chest and the head lowered, sulking.
